reference_provenance: Official Digimon Encyclopedia pages and the artwork linked by each page, resolved in ReferencesV2/sources.json. Existing previews and the old three reference boards were visually inspected before modelling. The old greymon and metalgreymon images depicted the 2010 anime forms and were rejected for this revision.

gabumon: Yellow reptile inside a pale striped wolf pelt
Wolf muzzle, inset red eyes, fangs, swept ears and one ringed forehead horn
Turquoise belly with red hooked marking
Hanging pelt side strips, magenta pelt talons and shorter reptile tail
greymon: Broad forward saurian torso and neck, small forward arms and substantial haunches
Long squared snout, separate hinged lower jaw, oral cavity and individual teeth
Open brown crown and cheek helmet with visible red eyes and three correctly oriented horns
Flush blue tiger markings, ventral scale seams and long articulated counterweight tail
metalgreymon: Orange Vaccine form rather than blue 2010 form
Asymmetric silver mechanical arm with enlarged three-pronged claw
Chest launcher doors, ports and rivets
Silver cranial panel, red sensor, paired ragged purple membranes and exposed tail vertebrae
garurumon: Lengthened four-legged ribcage with deep chest and distinct hindquarter proportions
Long canine muzzle, exposed fangs, inset almond eyes and broad flat pointed ears
Surface-following indigo coat stripes and irregular layered cheek fur
Individual paw digits, curved purple claws and articulated bushy tail
metalgarurumon: Long quadruped body and mechanical canine skull
Segmented joint armour with fitted bolts and shoulder launcher ports
Gold dorsal blade wings with vents
Separate toe claws, cranial panels and mechanical tail segments
tentomon: Split red beetle shell with black lateral spots
Large green compound eyes with small convex facets
Paired articulated antennae, layered mouth plate and ventral ribs
Six bent chitin limbs with hooked black extremities
kabuterimon: Dark ribbed helmet-like cranium without humanoid eyeballs
Large swept nasal horn and lateral helmet spurs
Toothed recessed jaw and mandible tusks
Four long framed wing membranes, six segmented limbs and heavy hind claws
atlur: Red broad carapace with emerald dorsal jewel
Forked rhino horn and ridged helmet recesses
Six bent limbs, pincer hands and large hooked toes
Four veined wings and segmented ventral abdomen
herakle: Gold broad crest and dual giant curved stag mandibles with inner teeth
Secondary rhino horn, ribbed head and toothed jaw
Six segmented appendages and large hook claws
Four pale veined wings and split gold dorsal shell
kuwagamon: Orange-red split elytra and heavily framed beetle face
Large curved paired stag mandibles with inward-facing teeth
Six articulated appendages with hooked hands and hind feet
Four narrow veined membranes and segmented abdomen
shellmon: Low pink amphibian mantle, thick rising neck and broad squared jaw
Open mouth, distinct teeth and tongue, inset blue almond eyes
Enlarged conical shell with coiled growth ridge, swept apex, pores and curved spines
Rounded webbed fingers, turquoise skin flecks and curved green crown tendrils

review.method: Rendered all eleven authored geometries in Blender Workbench at 720 pixels, comparing silhouettes to the official reference images; representative models underwent a second visual correction pass. Final integration performs its own animated export and pose validation.
review.skin: Only same-colour organic anatomical volumes are voxel-unified. Armour, markings, horns, shell, face layers and teeth retain separate geometry and bindings.

limits: These remain independently authored stylized 3D interpretations, not exact replicas or extracted original game assets.
Fine skin texture, painted fur texture, microscopic carapace detail and exact official character facial topology are not reproduced.
The existing standardized eight-clip motion system remains; species-specific original-game motion capture was not performed by this module.
Final animated clipping, engine framing and GPU shading must be checked after integration; temporary static renders alone do not certify them.
